in_hebrew.name: Norrie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Norrie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse name Nór, meaning 'dweller' or 'settler'. In the context of a feminine name, it could be interpreted as 'meadow dweller'.

in_greek.name: Norrie
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Meadow dweller
in_greek.long_meaning: Norrie είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Norse name Nór, meaning 'dweller' or 'settler'. In the context of a feminine name, it could be interpreted as 'meadow dweller'.

in_latin.name: Norrie
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Meadow dweller
in_latin.long_meaning: Norrie est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old Norse name Nór, meaning 'dweller' or 'settler'. In the context of a feminine name, it could be interpreted as 'meadow dweller'.
